summary: Comprehensive backend (21 pytest) and frontend (Playwright) testing of 四方收款平台 MVP. All backend endpoints work correctly: auth (JWT + cookie), dashboard stats w/ role-scoped profit, orders CRUD + simulate-pay + public endpoint, channels CRUD, accounts CRUD w/ adjust/freeze/reset-key, settlements reconciliation + payouts approve/reject + RBAC. Frontend: login via all 3 demo quick-fill buttons works and lands on dashboard; KPI cards + charts + recent orders render; create-order dialog with merchant/network select works; simulate-pay button works; channels/settlements/accounts pages render; USDT checkout page (/pay/{order_no}) renders QR, address, countdown, and simulate-payment flips to paid state; role-based nav restriction verified (merchant hides channels+accounts; agent hides channels); logout returns to login.
critical_code_review_comments: Seeded pending orders use expires_at = created_at + 15min across the last 7 days, so most seeded 'pending' orders are already expired. The orders list still shows them as 'pending' until the /public endpoint auto-expires on checkout access. Consider either (a) fixing seed to only mark very recent orders as pending, or (b) running a background sweep to normalize list status - minor UX inconsistency.
server.py is 793 lines - approaching the 700-line soft limit. Future refactor should split routes into submodules (auth, orders, channels, accounts, settlements).

CORS: allow_origins uses FRONTEND_URL env (good) but note cookie uses samesite='none' and secure=True which requires HTTPS (fine in preview). Login also returns token in JSON for Bearer flow, so even if cookies fail, auth works.
No rate limiting / brute force lockout on /auth/login - acceptable for MVP but should be added before production.
/orders/{order_no}/simulate-pay has no auth - it is a public endpoint intentionally for demo but should be removed or auth-gated in production.
